title: Case Research Pack
description: Structured, source-attributed research findings on a real criminal case, produced by the True Crime Research Director before any script is written. Every claim is traceable to a source and labeled by verification tier.

case_identity.description: Unambiguous identification of the case — critical when multiple cases share a common name.

case_name.description: Common name used for the case

legal_name.description: Official case/docket name if different from the common name

jurisdiction.description: Country/state/province where the case was tried or is pending

date_range.description: Approximate span of events, e.g. '2019-03 to 2021-11'

legal_status.description: Current legal status as of research_date — drives the wording rules downstream.

disambiguation_note.description: Required when another case shares this name — how this one was confirmed as the correct one

verified_summary.description: One paragraph using only [FACT]-tier information. No allegations stated as fact.

role.description: victim, suspect, defendant, witness, investigator, prosecutor, defense_attorney, judge, expert, other

confirmed.description: What is confirmed about this person, FACT-tier only

date_or_time.description: Date/time if known; omit rather than invent

verification.description: VERIFIED = court/official-record confirmed. ALLEGED = police/prosecution/party claim only. DISPUTED = sources conflict. UNCONFIRMED = single weak source.

kind.description: e.g. camera, phone_data, dna, testimony, physical, financial, witness, autopsy, other

investigation_narrative.description: Chronological account of how the investigation unfolded — FACT/ALLEGED tiers only, each major beat traceable to the timeline.

motive.description: Alleged motive and court-found motive must be kept separate — never merged into one statement.

story_worthy_facts.description: 5-10 verified details with narrative value, each traceable to timeline/evidence entries.

id.description: Short stable id referenced from source_ids elsewhere, e.g. 'src_01'

tier.description: A = court record/official filing/official agency. B = reputable journalism, named byline. C = secondary/syndicated/blog. D = social media/forum/unverified.

independent_of.description: Other source ids this one is a syndicated copy of — a copy is counted as one source with its original, not an independent one.

gaps.description: Facts the research could not confirm — surfaced explicitly rather than filled by inference.
